personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean structure fused with 4 Tactile layout (Senior-First)
personality_one_liner: A calm, highly readable, and trustworthy health companion designed explicitly for senior Indian users with oversized tap targets, zero abstract icons, and gentle tactile surfaces.

spacing.rule: Senior-first generous spacing. Ensure minimum 16px padding around all interactive elements to prevent accidental taps.

do's: Avoid glassmorphism. Use solid tactile cards to ensure high readability for seniors with vision degradation.
dont's: Do not use blur surfaces as they reduce contrast and clarity for older adults.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: A gentle, multi-step flow capturing language (22 Indian languages), voice assistant preferences, notification permissions, and emergency contacts.

states.loading: Centered prominent spinner with text 'Kripya pratiksha karein...'
states.error: Clear, plain-language error with a large 'Retry' button.

screens.layout: One question per screen. Large sticky CTA pinned to the bottom. Uses `cloud_white` user-defined gradient for background.

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: Provides an immediate view of the very next medicine to take, alongside today's remaining schedule and daily progress.

states.empty: Illustration of a calm setting with text 'No medicines scheduled today.'
states.error: Error message with a large refresh button.

screens.layout: Top section: Warm greeting + Progress ring. Middle: 'Next Medicine' hero card (using `peach_orange` gradient, large time/dose, prominent 'Taken' button). Bottom: Vertical list of today's remaining doses.

screens.name: Medicines List
screens.purpose: A comprehensive directory of all added medicines with their schedules.

states.empty: Friendly illustration with text 'Your medicine box is empty.' + Large primary 'Add Medicine' CTA.

screens.layout: Single-column list of chunky cards. Each card displays medicine name (large text), icon, and schedule summary. Floating action button for 'Add' with an explicit text label, not just an icon.

screens.name: Add/Edit Medicine
screens.purpose: Allows users (or their caretakers) to add a new medication, set schedule, and optional photo.

states.error: Field-specific red error messages in plain text.

screens.layout: Single-column form. Persistent labels above inputs (no floating labels). Large touch target selectors for time. Sticky 'Save Medicine' button at the bottom.

screens.name: Medicine Detail
screens.purpose: Shows full info of a specific medicine, history, and allows editing or deleting.

states.error: Failed to load details + Retry button.

screens.layout: Large hero photo/icon of the medicine. Chunky rows displaying dosage, frequency, and instructions. 'Edit' and 'Delete' presented as large distinct buttons.

screens.name: Camera Scanner (OCR)
screens.purpose: Helps users scan medicine strips/boxes to auto-fill details.

states.loading: Scanning animation with text 'Reading medicine name...'
states.error: Could not read text. Large 'Try Again' or 'Enter Manually' buttons.

screens.layout: Full-screen camera view with a clear central bounding box. A massive, high-contrast shutter button at the bottom.

screens.name: Scheduled Reminder & Dose Confirmation
screens.purpose: Full-screen interruption when it's time to take a pill, forcing a confirmation response.
screens.layout: Uses `peach_orange` or `sage_emerald` background gradient. Huge central medicine icon and name. Two massive horizontal buttons: 'Taken' (Green) and 'Skip' (Outlined/Secondary).

screens.name: Monthly Gradient Calendar
screens.purpose: Provides a bird's-eye view of medication adherence using the strict user-defined status gradients.
screens.layout: Standard grid layout, but cells are large. Each cell uses the exact specified gradients (calendar_green = all taken, calendar_yellow = partial, calendar_coral = missed, calendar_pale_grey = none scheduled). Today has a prominent sky-blue outline (`#0284C7`).

screens.name: AI Voice Assistant
screens.purpose: Allows users to ask questions or log medicines using voice in their native language.

states.error: I couldn't hear you. Please tap to try again.

screens.layout: Minimalist layout. Dominant central microphone button (40% of screen width). Real-time large transcription text below.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Manage app preferences, language, notifications, and emergency contacts.
screens.layout: Simple list view. Rows are minimum 64px tall. Icons are always paired with text. Clear separation between sections (Language, Notifications, Emergency).

welcome_illustration.alt: Happy elderly indian couple hugging outdoors

instructions_to_main_agent: SENIOR-FIRST UX: The baseline font size MUST be 18px (`base: 18`), scaling up to 36px. Do not use small captions.
TOUCH TARGETS: Every tappable element (buttons, list rows, tabs) MUST have a minimum height of 44pt (ideally 64pt for this demographic). Apply generous padding.
NO ORPHAN ICONS: Never use icons without text labels. Abstract icons are confusing for older adults. Always pair an icon with a descriptive string.

GRADIENTS: The exact `user_defined_gradients` (peach_orange, cloud_white, sage_emerald, sky_ocean, and the 4 calendar states) MUST be used exactly as provided via expo-linear-gradient. Do not approximate them with hex codes.
CALENDAR SPECIFICS: The calendar cells must use the exact status gradients. A cell with 'today' must have a sky-blue border overlaid on top of the status gradient.
CONTRAST: Text over any colored surface must maintain strict WCAG AAA contrast (use onBrand, onSuccess, etc.).
LAYOUT: Forms must use single-column layouts with persistent labels (no floating labels). Avoid horizontal scrolling wherever possible.
RTL & LOCALIZATION: Use Expo Localization. Keep layouts flex-friendly for Right-to-Left (RTL) support like Urdu.
Avoid Glassmorphism entirely. Ensure solid backgrounds for absolute readability.
Include explicit multisensory feedback via Haptics for dose confirmations and button interactions.
